vicious_mockery.name: Vicious Mockery
vicious_mockery.description: You unleash a string of insults laced with subtle enchantments. Target takes 1d4 psychic damage and has disadvantage on its next attack.

eldritch_blast.name: Eldritch Blast
eldritch_blast.description: A beam of crackling eldritch energy streaks toward a creature within range (1d10 force damage; fires 2 beams at Level 5).

fire_bolt.name: Fire Bolt
fire_bolt.description: You hurl a mote of fire at a creature. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, 1d10 fire damage (ignites grease surfaces).

ray_of_frost.name: Ray of Frost
ray_of_frost.description: A frigid beam of blue-white light streaks toward a creature, dealing 1d8 cold damage and slowing its movement.

shocking_grasp.name: Shocking Grasp
shocking_grasp.description: Lightning springs from your hand to deliver a shock (1d8 lightning damage, dazes target and electrifies water surfaces).

sacred_flame.name: Sacred Flame
sacred_flame.description: Flame-like radiance descends on a creature, which must succeed on a DEX save or take 1d8 radiant damage.

mage_hand.name: Mage Hand
mage_hand.description: A spectral, floating hand appears to manipulate distant objects and open doors.

light.name: Light
light.description: You touch an object, causing it to shed bright light in a 20-foot radius.

healing_word.name: Healing Word
healing_word.description: [Bonus Action] A creature of your choice that you can see regains HP equal to 1d4 + spellcasting modifier.

cure_wounds.name: Cure Wounds
cure_wounds.description: A creature you touch regains 1d8 + spellcasting modifier HP.

magic_missile.name: Magic Missile
magic_missile.description: Three glowing darts of magical force automatically strike your foe (3 x 1d4+1 force damage; +1 dart per upcast slot level).

shield_spell.name: Shield
shield_spell.description: [Bonus Action / Reaction] An invisible barrier of magical force appears to deflect attacks (+5 AC for 2 rounds).

detect_magic.name: Detect Magic
detect_magic.description: For the duration, you sense the presence of magic within 30 feet of you.

bless.name: Bless
bless.description: [Concentration] Blesses your party, adding +1d4 to all attack rolls and saving throws for 5 rounds.

divine_favor.name: Divine Favor
divine_favor.description: [Bonus Action, Concentration] Your prayer empowers you with divine radiance. Weapon attacks deal an extra 1d4 radiant damage.

thunderous_smite.name: Thunderous Smite
thunderous_smite.description: [Bonus Action] Your weapon rings with thunder! Deals 2d6 thunder damage and knocks the target prone on a failed STR save.

hex.name: Hex
hex.description: [Bonus Action, Concentration] Place a dark curse on an enemy, dealing 1d6 necrotic damage and causing your attacks against it to deal +1d6 necrotic damage!

hellish_rebuke.name: Hellish Rebuke
hellish_rebuke.description: [Bonus Action / Reaction] Point your finger and surround the foe in hellish flames (2d10 fire damage, DEX save for half).

armor_of_agathys.name: Armor of Agathys
armor_of_agathys.description: A protective magical frost surrounds you, granting +5 Temporary HP (scales +5 per upcast level), +1 AC, and 5 cold retaliation.

arms_of_hadar.name: Arms of Hadar
arms_of_hadar.description: [AoE] Tendrils of dark energy erupt from you and batter all nearby enemies for 2d6 necrotic damage and daze them.

burning_hands.name: Burning Hands
burning_hands.description: [AoE] A thin sheet of flames shoots forth from your outstretched fingertips, burning all enemies for 3d6 fire damage.

inflict_wounds.name: Inflict Wounds
inflict_wounds.description: Make a melee spell attack against a creature you can reach. On a hit, the target takes a devastating 3d10 necrotic damage.

sleep.name: Sleep
sleep.description: Sends a creature into magical slumber for 2 rounds. Sleeping creatures skip their turn and melee hits against them are automatic critical hits!

thunderwave.name: Thunderwave
thunderwave.description: [AoE] A wave of thunderous force sweeps out from you. Enemies must CON save or take 2d8 thunder damage and be knocked prone.

guiding_bolt.name: Guiding Bolt
guiding_bolt.description: A flash of light streaks toward a creature. On a hit, deals 4d6 radiant damage and grants Advantage on the next attack against it!

charm_person.name: Charm Person
charm_person.description: You attempt to charm a humanoid you can see. On a failed WIS save, it is charmed and dazed for 3 rounds.

scorching_ray.name: Scorching Ray
scorching_ray.description: You create three rays of fire and hurl them at your foes (3 separate ranged spell attacks dealing 2d6 fire damage each!).

misty_step.name: Misty Step
misty_step.description: [Bonus Action] Surrounded by silvery mist, you teleport to high ground! Grants High Ground (+2 ranged attack) and +2 AC.

shatter.name: Shatter
shatter.description: [AoE] A sudden loud ringing noise erupts, hitting all enemies for 3d8 thunder damage (CON save for half).

hold_person.name: Hold Person
hold_person.description: [Concentration] Paralyzes (holds) an enemy on a failed WIS save. Held foes skip their turn and attacks against them are AUTOMATIC CRITICAL HITS!

spiritual_weapon.name: Spiritual Weapon
spiritual_weapon.description: [Bonus Action] You create a floating spectral weapon that strikes a foe for 1d8+3 force damage as a bonus action!

invisibility.name: Invisibility
invisibility.description: [Concentration] You become invisible! Grants Advantage on your next attack and enemies have Disadvantage attacking you.

mirror_image.name: Mirror Image
mirror_image.description: Three illusory duplicates of yourself appear, confounding attackers (+3 AC for 3 rounds, no concentration required).

prayer_of_healing.name: Prayer of Healing
prayer_of_healing.description: [Party Heal] Up to six creatures of your choice regain 2d8 + modifier hit points.

fireball.name: Fireball
fireball.description: [AoE Level 3] A bright streak flashes from your pointing finger and blossoms into an explosion of flame, dealing 8d6 fire damage to ALL enemies!

lightning_bolt.name: Lightning Bolt
lightning_bolt.description: [AoE Level 3] A stroke of lightning forming a 100-foot line blasts all enemies for 8d6 lightning damage (electrifies water).

spirit_guardians.name: Spirit Guardians
spirit_guardians.description: [AoE Level 3, Concentration] Call forth angelic spirits to protect you, dealing 3d8 radiant damage to all enemies and slowing them!

haste.name: Haste
haste.description: [Level 3, Concentration] Grants +2 AC and an immediate extra Action! (Best combat buff in Baldur's Gate 3).

mass_healing_word.name: Mass Healing Word
mass_healing_word.description: [Bonus Action, Party Heal] A wave of healing energy restores 1d4+4 HP to you and all companions at once!

remove_curse.name: Remove Curse
remove_curse.description: At your touch, all curses affecting one creature or object end.

shield.name: Shield
shield.description: [Bonus Action / Reaction] An invisible barrier of magical force appears to deflect attacks (+5 AC for 2 rounds).

shield_of_faith.name: Shield of Faith
shield_of_faith.description: [Bonus Action, Concentration] A shimmering field surrounds a creature of your choice, granting +2 AC.

command.name: Command
command.description: You speak a one-word command ('Halt' or 'Grovel') to a creature, forcing it prone on a failed WIS save.

lesser_restoration.name: Lesser Restoration
lesser_restoration.description: You touch a creature and restore 1d6+3 HP while curing poison or debilitating conditions.

silence.name: Silence
silence.description: [AoE, Concentration] Creates a sphere of absolute silence, dazing enemy spellcasters.

magic_weapon.name: Magic Weapon
magic_weapon.description: [Bonus Action, Concentration] Imbues your weapon with arcane power (+1d4 damage and +1 AC).

minor_illusion.name: Minor Illusion
minor_illusion.description: Create an illusory distraction that grants you Hidden (Advantage on your next attack).

revivify.name: Revivify
revivify.description: Restores a fallen or gravely wounded ally with a surge of divine life (3d8+4 HP).

hypnotic_pattern.name: Hypnotic Pattern
hypnotic_pattern.description: [AoE Level 3, Concentration] A twisting pattern of colors incapacitates enemies on a failed WIS save.

hunger_of_hadar.name: Hunger of Hadar
hunger_of_hadar.description: [AoE Level 3, Concentration] Opens a gateway to the dark void between stars, dealing 4d6 cold/acid damage and slowing all enemies.

counterspell.name: Counterspell
counterspell.description: [Reaction / Bonus Action] Disrupts enemy magic and wards you with an arcane barrier (+4 AC for 2 rounds).

guidance.name: Guidance
guidance.description: [Cantrip, Social & Skill Assist] Touch a willing creature to grant +1d4 bonus to their ability and dialogue checks.

friends.name: Friends
friends.description: [Cantrip, Social Charm] Grants Advantage (roll 2d20 take highest) on all Charisma dialogue checks (Persuasion, Deception, Intimidation, Performance).

thaumaturgy.name: Thaumaturgy
thaumaturgy.description: [Cantrip, Divine Presence] Booming voice and glowing eyes grant Advantage on Intimidation and Performance checks.

speak_with_animals.name: Speak with Animals
speak_with_animals.description: [BG3 Social Ritual] Comprehend and verbally converse with beasts and animals in any scene to uncover hidden secrets.

speak_with_dead.name: Speak with Dead
speak_with_dead.description: [BG3 Social Ritual] Call forth the spirit of a corpse or ancient skeleton to answer questions about its life, killer, or hidden treasures.

detect_thoughts.name: Detect Thoughts
detect_thoughts.description: [BG3 Mind-Reading] Read the surface thoughts and hidden secrets of NPCs during conversation, granting Advantage on Insight and social checks.

disguise_self.name: Disguise Self
disguise_self.description: [BG3 Social Illusion] Magically alter your appearance, voice, and attire to infiltrate hostile factions or gain Advantage on Deception checks.

hunters_mark.name: Hunter's Mark
hunters_mark.description: [Bonus Action, Concentration] Mark a quarry as your prey, dealing +1d6 extra weapon damage on every hit.

entangle.name: Entangle
entangle.description: [AoE, Concentration] Grasping weeds and vines sprout from the ground, restraining enemies and granting Advantage on attacks against them.
